inputs.original_text: These anti-Trump radicals launched their so-called "No Kings" rally with crowds packing the streets in open defiance of established leadership, but federal officers had no choice but to respond with tear gas and arrests to restore control. The situation descended into chaos because of the volatile crowd, prompting authorities to order everyone to disperse, and at least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is the predictable result when left-wing agitators reject traditional authority, national institutions, and the rule of law in favor of disruption and demands that threaten social order.
inputs.modified_text: These anti-Trump radicals kicked off their so-called "No Kings" rally by packing the streets in open defiance of established leadership and our national institutions. Federal officers had no choice but to deploy tear gas and carry out arrests to restore order after the volatile crowd turned the situation into chaos and forced authorities to issue dispersal orders. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is exactly the kind of predictable breakdown that occurs when left-wing agitators reject traditional authority and the rule of law, choosing disruption over the social order that has always protected our families, culture, and way of life.
